card.name: Digits and quantity words before counts
card.fires_on: Digits inside numbers (like 26k, 70, 19%) and quantity words such as 'more than one', 'another', 'only', 'every' that come right before a count or kind of thing being quantified.

modes.label: Inside numbers
modes.description: A digit within a multi-digit figure for people, percentages or counts in news or survey text.

modes.label: Quantity words
modes.description: A quantifier like one, another, only or every that sets up a count or a type of item.
